svg.text: 15-D supersingular hypercube of j - 744, projected to a rotating 3-D shadow
interior dots = projected centroids of the divisibility fingerprints fp(c(n))
Verified: OR of fp over first 128 coefficients = 32767 (all 15 axes hit).
Self-pointers (firstHit p = p): p = 7 (supersingular) and p = 101.
